Okay, I just have a few questions:

1: This is more of a verification than a question. Body arsenal and
Kraken's Kiss...do-able? I say no due to the definition of "hand
strike", however, since KK says "*strength* +1" (empahsis mine) I could
almost believe it is a hand strike.

2: Form of Mist (SUP): Does the blocking vampire get to untap? Can it
use a reaction card to continue blocking?

3: Blood Hunt vote after a diablerie: The rules say that reaction and
action modifiers cannot be played during the blood hunt since it is not
an "action", however, it makes no mention of playing political action
cards to add votes during the referendum. Can this be done?

Thanks,

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 24 Nov 2000 16:24:39 GMT, Totengraber
<totengr...@yahoo.com> wrote:

>Okay, I just have a few questions:
>
>1: This is more of a verification than a question. Body arsenal and
>Kraken's Kiss...do-able? I say no due to the definition of "hand
>strike", however, since KK says "*strength* +1" (empahsis mine) I could
>almost believe it is a hand strike.

Your first thought was correct; this is why "strength" and "hand
damage" were distinguished the way they were in all the
errata/reprints, so that it would be easy to determine which was a
type of strike, and which simply referred to the amount. =)

>2: Form of Mist (SUP): Does the blocking vampire get to untap? Can it
>use a reaction card to continue blocking?

no text on Form of Mist to permit untapping, so no untap.

You can Wake and continue attempting to block, but you must generate
an additional +1 intercept (per text on Form of Mist). If you were
already Woken, you just need the intercept, as Wake lasts for the
duration of the current action, and the action hasn't concluded yet.

>3: Blood Hunt vote after a diablerie: The rules say that reaction and
>action modifiers cannot be played during the blood hunt since it is not
>an "action", however, it makes no mention of playing political action
>cards to add votes during the referendum. Can this be done?

You can drop a single PA for a single vote during the referendum, yes.

Messages.Body:
Totengraber wrote:
>
> Okay, I just have a few questions:
>
> 1: This is more of a verification than a question. Body arsenal and
> Kraken's Kiss...do-able? I say no due to the definition of "hand
> strike", however, since KK says "*strength* +1" (empahsis mine) I could
> almost believe it is a hand strike.

The combo is only effective in as far as Body Arsenal boosts your
strength. The KK strike is not a hand strike, so can't be made aggravated
by Body Arsenal.

> 2: Form of Mist (SUP): Does the blocking vampire get to untap? Can it
> use a reaction card to continue blocking?

No. Yes, if it can untap or behave as if it were untapped.

\> 3: Blood Hunt vote after a diablerie: The rules say that reaction and

> action modifiers cannot be played during the blood hunt since it is not
> an "action", however, it makes no mention of playing political action
> cards to add votes during the referendum. Can this be done?

Yes, one per Methuselah.
